A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PLD research work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, implementation listing and appendices are readable, and retained content can be matched across reorganization and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original ImageNet-1K distillation experiments, ablations, distribution-matching measurements and loss-landscape analyses in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original results and adds CIFAR-100 classification, MS-COCO detection and runtime measurements, including Tables 1, 7 and 13.

M1.justification: The teacher-optimal ordering, teacher-confidence weighting and PLD objective in Section 4 remain unchanged. Appendix C contains the same executable loss implementation. The detection experiments introduce no documented algorithmic modification.

E1.justification: v1 evaluates ImageNet-1K classification. v3 retains that coverage and adds CIFAR-100 small-image classification and MS-COCO object detection, substantially extending both the represented data and task requirements.

E2.justification: v3 Table 1 adds evaluated comparisons with AT, FitNet, PKT, RKD, SP, VID and DKD alongside KD and DIST. Table 7 also compares PLD with DKD for detection. These extend v1's comparator coverage substantially; the original ImageNet comparison sets are retained.

E3.justification: New protocols include CIFAR-100 training for 250 epochs with AdamW, batch size 128 and temperature 4 for PLD and DIST. COCO evaluation introduces Faster R-CNN/FPN configurations and val2017 AP, AP50, AP75 and object-size metrics. The original ImageNet training and validation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix I and Table 13 examine whether PLD's sorting operation introduces practical training overhead. The existing temperature, optimizer, logit-standardization, divergence and distribution-matching analyses are retained. The loss-landscape analysis moves from Appendix I to J without substantive change.

E5.justification: v1 explicitly reports no error bars or multiple runs. v3 adds three independent CIFAR-100 runs, different-seed information and mean-plus/minus reporting, but does not extend uncertainty reporting to the retained ImageNet results or COCO. Section 5.1 calls the uncertainty standard deviation, whereas checklist item 7 calls it standard error.

E6.justification: The matched original numerical results remain unchanged. v3 adds CIFAR accuracies, COCO detection metrics and CIFAR training times. New comparisons include mixed outcomes: CIFAR heterogeneous accuracy is 68.16% for PLD versus 69.51% for DKD; COCO AP is 32.47 versus 32.11 for ResNet-101 to ResNet-18, but 28.91 versus 29.24 for ResNet-50 to MobileNetV2.

T1.justification: The formal PL model and PLD definitions, convexity argument, gradient derivation and smoothness analysis remain unchanged. Appendix A adjusts equation layout without changing the derivation. The runtime discussion restates the previously identified O(C log C) sorting complexity.

C1.justification: v1's abstract and contribution statement emphasize quantified classification gains over KD and DIST. v3 replaces this emphasis with claims spanning CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1K and MS-COCO, including comparisons against feature-based methods. This materially broadens the empirical contribution claim while retaining the original methodological claims.

C2.justification: v3 interprets the detection results as evidence of structured knowledge transfer to dense prediction without detector modification. It also qualifies the sorting-cost limitation with an empirical claim of negligible overhead for common architectures. The aligned-label requirement and weak-teacher-confidence limitation remain.

D1.justification: v3 documents the new CIFAR recipe, including optimizer parameters, learning rate, weight decay, augmentations and temperatures, and adds detector specifications and measured training times. Existing PLD code and ImageNet resource details are retained. COCO schedules are described as identical without numerical schedule details.

R1.justification: Nine references are added for CIFAR-100, COCO, FPN and additional distillation comparators, including AT, FitNet, PKT, SP, VID and DKD. Section 2 retains essentially the same positioning relative to ListMLE, P-ListMLE and RankDistil; the additions mainly support expanded experimental comparisons.

P1.justification: Substantial sentence-level rewriting affects the abstract, introduction, related work, method discussion and experimental narrative. Experiments are reorganized into dataset-specific sections, with the original ImageNet studies nested together. v3 also adds acknowledgments and a runtime appendix, making this more than a local wording revision.

P2.justification: v3 adds CIFAR accuracy-and-uncertainty, multi-metric detection and runtime tables, and reorganizes the main experimental displays. The full baseline-ablation table is redesigned with grouped headers and highlighted configurations. Original figure content is retained, with the two loss-landscape figures reordered and renumbered.

improvement.justification: v3 substantially strengthens v1's ImageNet-centered evidence through CIFAR comparisons with additional distillation methods, COCO detection tests and measured runtime costs (Tables 1, 7 and 13). These address important gaps in comparator breadth, task generality and practical efficiency while preserving the original method and results. CIFAR repeated-run reporting also improves empirical assessment. The benefits are qualified by inconsistent standard-deviation/standard-error terminology, incomplete COCO settings and broader 'consistent gains' wording that needs qualification where DKD wins.
